blueprint.name: Mirror F5 artifacts from FAR into a private registry
blueprint.description: Replicate the BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes supply chain out of F5's Artifact Registry into a private OCI registry, then verify every artifact by digest. Needs no cluster: this is the step that makes a disconnected install possible, and it can run long before one. Point it at any registry you already run, or deploy one with the Harbor blueprint — when Harbor is part of the same deployment the registry address and its CA are wired in automatically.

outcomes: Every image, chart and file in the BNK manifest is present in the target registry
Each artifact verified by digest against its source in FAR
The registry is ready for a disconnected BNK install to pull from

prerequisites.description: An IBM Cloud credential template on the project — the mirror reads the FAR auth key and subscription JWT from COS with it.

A reachable OCI registry with a project/repository the supplied credentials can push into. Harbor does not create the project on first push; a missing one answers 401, which reads like a bad credential.
That registry's CA if it is self-signed, or its SHA-256 pin — roksbnkctl refuses to adopt a captured CA without one. Deploy the registry with the Harbor blueprint and this is wired in automatically.

input_summary.label: One phase
input_summary.value: init -> registry replicate --target generic -> registry verify

input_summary.label: Idempotent
input_summary.value: Artifacts already present at the same digest are skipped, so re-running against a populated registry costs minutes, not the full transfer

required.name: registry_generic_host
required.label: Private registry host
required.description: The private registry (e.g. Harbor) BNK's charts and images are mirrored into and pulled from. For an air-gapped cluster this is its PRIVATE IP or DNS name, reached over the Transit Gateway.

required.name: cos_bucket
required.label: Supply-chain COS bucket
required.description: Orchestration COS bucket holding the FAR auth tarball and the subscription JWT. The runner has no local copies, so it resolves them from here; buckets provisioned by `roksbnkctl init` carry a per-account suffix (bnk-artifacts-<account>).

required.name: manifest_version
required.label: BNK manifest version
required.description: BNK manifest release to install. Blank = the roksbnkctl default.

optional.name: prefix
optional.label: Resource prefix
optional.description: Prefix for resource names roksbnkctl creates (e.g. acme-eu).

optional.name: region
optional.label: IBM Cloud region
optional.description: Region the cluster lives in. Inherits from the selected credential template.

optional.name: resource_group
optional.label: Resource group
optional.description: IBM Cloud resource group. Inherits from the selected credential template.

optional.name: registry_repo_prefix
optional.label: Registry repository prefix
optional.description: Project / repository prefix inside the mirror (a Harbor project, an Artifactory repo key).

optional.name: registry_username
optional.label: Registry username
optional.description: Username the mirror is pushed to and pulled from.

optional.name: registry_password
optional.label: Registry password
optional.description: Password / access token for that user. Stored base64 in the workspace config, never logged.

optional.name: registry_ca_b64
optional.label: Registry CA (base64)
optional.description: Base64 PEM of the private registry's CA. v1.35.0 REFUSES to auto-capture a self-signed mirror's CA over the wire, so supply it here (or pin it below) — this is the CA you generated for the registry.

optional.name: registry_ca_sha256
optional.label: Registry CA SHA-256 pin
optional.description: SHA-256 pin of the registry's served chain, enforced during the TLS handshake. Accepts bare hex, sha256:…, colon-separated, or raw `openssl x509 -fingerprint -sha256` output.

optional.name: cos_instance
optional.label: Supply-chain COS instance
optional.description: COS instance holding the FAR auth key + subscription JWT. Blank = bnk-supply-chain.

optional.name: cos_region
optional.label: Supply-chain COS region
optional.description: Region of that bucket. Blank = us-south.

optional.name: far_auth_file
optional.label: FAR auth object name
optional.description: Object name of the FAR auth tarball in the bucket. Blank = f5-far-auth-key.tgz.

optional.name: subscription_jwt_file
optional.label: Subscription JWT object name
optional.description: Object name of the subscription JWT in the bucket. Blank = subscription.jwt.

modules.name: roksbnkctl FAR Mirror
modules.description: Replicate FAR -> private registry, then verify every artifact by digest.
